ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace air crew officers. Flight command and emergency response determine lives and mission success, so decision authority remains human. AI assists with route planning, situational awareness, data organization, and training simulations, compressing information into forms that support judgment. Officers still make final decisions and lead teams.

Uncrewed aircraft swarm mission planning
Digital simulator training
Big-data decision analysis

Leadership: develop mission-capable crews.
Flight skills: airborne maneuvers and coordination.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places air crew officers in the low-moderate AI exposure range. Data processing and planning assistance are becoming automated, while officers remain responsible for command decisions, emergencies, instruction, and team leadership. AI supports decisions rather than replacing the decision-maker.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still brings change. Uncrewed operations and AI decision support reshape aircrew work. Officers must use AI tools, understand data, and strengthen command judgment. Human-AI collaboration becomes a new source of combat effectiveness.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Military academies and university flight recruitment are the main entry routes. Physical standards and background screening are firm requirements, and strong academics also matter. Build fitness, English, and science and engineering foundations during school.

Adapt to information-driven operations by learning AI decision support and simulation training systems while strengthening command and instruction. Turn flight and mission experience into standards and develop younger personnel.

People outside flight specialties can build experience in ground command, intelligence, or support before seeking flight selection or transfer. Emphasize discipline, resilience, and learning ability during selection.

Military development should emphasize human-machine coordination. Give officers effective AI decision-support tools while strengthening realistic training and command development. Create clear advancement for officers who command, teach, and understand data.

ai_s7_trends: Military aviation becomes more information-driven and uncrewed, with wider AI decision support.
Flight officers evolve from operators toward commanders and decision-makers.
Uncrewed aircraft and big data create new assignment paths.

ai_s3_list: 指挥决断：高压下快速定案。
应急处置：特情面前稳住局面。

飞行技能：空中动作与协同。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明空勤军官是「中高曝光」的军事指挥岗位：数据处理和规划辅助正在自动化，但指挥决断、应急处置、带教带队仍需军官本人，AI 是决策支持工具而非替代者。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于不变：无人化作战和 AI 决策辅助在改变空勤形态，军官要会用 AI 工具、懂数据判断，同时强化指挥和决策能力——人和 AI 的组合才是新战斗力。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想走空勤军官路线，军校或大学招飞是主要入口：身体条件和政审是硬门槛，文化课成绩也要过硬；在校期间把体能、英语和理工基础打牢，机会更多。
适应信息化转型：学会用 AI 决策辅助和模拟训练系统，强化指挥和带教能力；同时把飞行和任务经验总结成标准，培养后辈就是你的价值。
非飞行专业想进入空勤体系，可从地面指挥、情报、保障等岗位积累，再争取选飞或转岗；面试与选拔中突出纪律性、抗压和学习能力。
部队建设要「人机协同」：给军官配好 AI 决策辅助工具，同时强化实战化训练和指挥能力培养；让能指挥、会带教、懂数据的军官有清晰的晋升通道。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can simulate a year of climate data in moments, but teachers use disciplinary judgment to decide whether an anomaly deserves deeper study and how to explain it to students.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 14,000 people employed in this postsecondary teaching field in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 14,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 400 jobs, with roughly 1,000 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $101,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postsecondary Earth science teachers, but it will reshape data processing. Model simulation, image recognition, and literature review are becoming much faster, reducing the value of basic repetitive analysis. Teachers create value by framing questions, designing experiments, interpreting results, and developing talent. These abilities come from disciplinary judgment and years of experience that models cannot replace.
ai_s2_accel: AI-accelerated weather and ocean model simulations
Automated interpretation of remote-sensing imagery
Online laboratory platforms that expand instruction
Data visualization for clearer research communication
ai_s2_auto: Automated processing and charting of observational data
Literature searches and first-draft reviews
Rapid creation of courseware and teaching materials
Initial grading of assignments and laboratory reports
ai_s3_list: Disciplinary judgment: identifying genuine questions that deserve research.
Laboratory guidance: teaching scientific methods through equipment and data.
Field safety and experience: making sound decisions while leading fieldwork in harsh conditions.
Science communication: making complex phenomena compelling to students.
Talent development: identifying suitable directions for students and advancing their growth.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10, moderate, reflects how AI is reshaping the data side of Earth science teaching and research. Model simulation, data processing, and literature review are becoming much faster. Disciplinary judgment, laboratory guidance, field experience, and talent development remain human strengths. As AI use grows, sound judgment becomes more valuable.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure signals a need to upgrade skills. Scholars who use AI for data analysis and first drafts of literature reviews can devote more time to observation and original research. Interdisciplinary work combining AI and Earth science is one of the field's most active directions, and early entrants gain an advantage.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Earth science rewards genuine commitment. Doctoral training is lengthy, and faculty positions are highly competitive. Students should join a laboratory and participate in fieldwork during undergraduate study to confirm their interest in natural science. Pursuing the field only for the title of university professor can lead to a difficult career path.

Build AI data-tool and programming skills, then target policy priorities such as climate, oceans, and the carbon cycle. Seek major observation programs and interdisciplinary projects. Beyond publications, the ability to lead projects is a key asset for promotion.

Earth science doctorate holders can move into meteorological and oceanographic agencies, natural-resource organizations, environmental consulting, and carbon services. Add data analysis and modeling skills, then emphasize an end-to-end observation, data, and model workflow in job applications.

When hiring Earth science teachers, assess laboratory instruction, field-team leadership, and willingness to collaborate across disciplines in addition to publication volume. Giving early-career faculty AI computing resources and data platforms can materially increase research output.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automated image classification and feature extraction
Archiving and sharing observations across multiple periods

ai_s7_trends: AI-enabled Earth science is becoming a growth area, with continued expansion in interdisciplinary research positions.
Policy attention to climate, oceans, hazards, and space science is increasing demand for faculty.
As data tools spread, teachers create more value through identifying research questions and developing talent.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年土方、船舶、教师、高等教育在岗约 1.40 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.44 万人，净增约 0.04 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.10 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.14 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代高校地学教师，但会重构「数据处理」环节：模式模拟、影像识别、综述整理都被大幅提速，低水平的重复分析正在贬值。教师的价值集中在问题提出、实验设计、结果解释和人才培养上——这些是学科直觉与长期积累的产物，模型替代不了。

ai_s3_list: 学科判断：知道哪些问题是真问题、值得研究。
实验指导：在设备与数据面前教学生科学方法。
野外安全与经验：恶劣环境下带队考察的决断。
科学表达：把复杂现象讲得让学生着迷。
人才培养：判断学生适合的方向并托举。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明地学教学科研的「数据端」正在被 AI 重构：模式模拟、数据处理、文献整理效率大幅提升。但学科判断、实验指导、野外经验和人才培养是教师不可替代的部分，AI 越多，判断力的价值越凸显。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中位曝光是升级信号：会用 AI 做数据分析、写综述初稿的学者，能省出大量时间投入观测和原创研究。交叉学科（AI + 地球科学）正是当前最活跃的方向，先上车的占先机。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 地学是「真爱才入行」的方向：博士周期长、教职竞争激烈。建议孩子在本科阶段就进实验室和野外感受，确认对自然科学的热情；如果只是想要「大学老师」的名头，这条路会走得很苦。
把 AI 数据工具和编程能力补上，往气候、海洋、碳循环等政策热点方向靠。多争取重大观测和交叉课题，论文之外，「能牵头项目」是晋升的关键筹码。
地学博士可转型气象海洋部门、自然资源系统、环境咨询与双碳服务。先补数据分析与建模技能，求职时突出「观测 + 数据 + 模型」的完整链条能力。
招地学教师时，除了论文数量，建议考察「实验教学能力 + 野外带队经验 + 交叉合作意愿」。给年轻教师配 AI 计算资源和数据平台，能显著提升科研产出。

ai_s7_trends: AI 地球科学成为学科增长点，交叉研究岗位持续增加。
气候、海洋、灾害与空间科学受政策关注，师资需求上升。
数据工具普及，教师价值向问题发现与人才培养集中。

Engineers focus on architecture decisions, physical tradeoffs, accountability, and original design. Connect existing electronics, firmware, or manufacturing experience to hardware engineering and identify a differentiated entry point.

Use AI to reduce repetitive hardware work and focus engineers on architecture and decisions.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can draw circuits and diagnose common faults, but a technician still needs trained hands and eyes to interpret the burned smell after a prototype fails or an unexplained oscilloscope glitch.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 93,700 Electrical and electronic engineering technologists and technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 94,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 600 jobs, with about 8,400 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $77,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Electrical and electronic engineering technologists and technicians, but it will take over drawing, test-data organization, and common fault diagnosis. Soldering, assembly, field testing, and exception analysis combine hardware with software, making near-term replacement unlikely.
ai_s2_accel: Automated test benches for batch testing
AI-assisted component fault localization
Circuit simulation that predicts performance
Digital twins for system testing
ai_s2_auto: AI-assisted circuit diagram and PCB layout generation
Automated test-data collection and organization
AI diagnosis of common faults
Automated test report generation
ai_s3_list: Soldering and assembly control: sound joints, correct spacing, and no bridges require skilled hands.
Troubleshooting logic: when tests pass but a board fails, experience guides step-by-step localization.
Exception recognition: instruments cannot always explain odd waveforms, abnormal heat, or unusual sounds.
Engineer collaboration: translating test findings into design language requires communication.
On-site response: restore production quickly after equipment or testing failures.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this occupation in the moderate AI exposure range. AI software increasingly handles drawing, data analysis, and documentation, while people remain central to hardware assembly, testing, and troubleshooting.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean unemployment. AI takes standardized skills. Automated equipment replaces repetitive wiring, testing, and assembly, but technicians with embedded debugging, automated test development, and system integration skills gain value by working with AI.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study electrical automation or electronic information systems. Balance theory with laboratory work and electronic design competitions. Add embedded systems and Python-based automated testing so you can write test programs as well as debug boards.

Move from manual testing to automated testing. Learn Python and LabVIEW, and turn repetitive tests into scripts. Progress toward embedded debugging and system integration instead of stopping at soldering and multimeter work.

People with electronics fundamentals can start as testers, but set a schedule. Learn instruments and troubleshooting within a year, then automated testing within two years. On a resume, describe test benches built and fault types resolved rather than listing instruments.

Do not hire technicians on education alone. Test practical skill by asking candidates to solder a board and diagnose a fault. Prioritize people who understand automated testing and embedded systems because they can grow with AI-enabled production.

ai_s7_trends: Automated testing spreads across production, narrowing manual testing roles and increasing demand for technicians who write test scripts.
Growth in new energy and automotive electronics shifts demand toward power electronics, BMS, and embedded systems.
AI diagnostic tools enter production lines, moving technicians from fault finders to validators and safeguards for AI results.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年电气与电子工程技师与技术员在岗约 9.37 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.43 万人，净增约 0.06 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.84 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.72 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代电气电子技师，但会接管画图、测试数据整理和常见故障诊断。剩下的焊接装配、现场调试、异常排查，是软硬件结合的功夫，机器短期替不了。
ai_s2_accel: 自动化测试台批量跑测
AI 辅助定位元器件故障
仿真软件预判电路性能
数字孪生辅助系统调试
ai_s2_auto: 电路图与 PCB 布局 AI 辅助生成
测试数据自动采集与整理
常见故障的 AI 自动诊断
测试报告自动生成
ai_s3_list: 焊接与装配手感：焊点饱满不虚焊、间距不连锡，是手上功夫。
故障排查思路：测试全过但板子不工作，靠的是逐级定位的经验。
异常识别：波形怪、发热异常、异响，很多问题仪器说不清。
与工程师的协作：把测试发现翻译成设计语言，是沟通本事。
现场应变：设备趴窝、测试中断，怎么快速恢复产线。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业的绘图、数据分析、文档比重偏高，这些正被 AI 软件接管；但硬件的装配、调试与排故仍是人的主战场。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高风险不等于失业。AI 抢的是「标准化技能」——纯接线测试、重复装配会被自动化设备替代；但会嵌入式调试、自动化测试开发、系统集成的技师，反而站在 AI 肩膀上更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选电气自动化或电子信息专业，别只学理论，多泡实验室、多参加电子设计竞赛。AI 时代加学嵌入式、Python 自动化测试，把「会调板子」升级成「会写测试程序调板子」。
主动从手工测试转向自动化测试——学 Python、LabVIEW，把重复测试写成脚本。往嵌入式调试、系统集成方向走，别让手艺停在焊板和万用表。
有电子基础想入行，从测试员做起可以，但要给自己定时间表：一年内掌握仪器与排故，两年内会写自动化测试。简历写「搭建过XX测试台、定位过XX类故障」，比罗列仪器名有用。
招技师别只看学历，考动手：现场焊一块板、排查一个故障，立刻见真章。优先招会自动化测试、懂嵌入式的，这类人不会被 AI 替代，能跟你一起升级。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 原理图与 PCB 自动布线

ai_s7_trends: 自动化测试全面普及，纯手工测试岗收窄，会写测试脚本的技师吃香。
新能源与汽车电子扩张，电气电子技师需求向电力电子、BMS、嵌入式倾斜。
AI 诊断工具进产线，技师角色从「排故员」转向「AI 结果的验证与兜底人」。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can optimize assembly-line cycle times, but experienced workers still determine how to route a wire harness, how tightly to torque a screw, and where an unusual sound originates.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 261,400 Electromechanical Equipment Assemblers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 273,300 by 2034, a net gain of about 11,900 jobs, with about 29,600 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $44,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not fully replace Electromechanical Equipment Assemblers, but it will reshape the occupation. Robots and automated lines increasingly perform standardized assembly-station tasks. Workers will focus more on equipment commissioning, exception handling, and quality control, which require judgment. Assemblers need to develop multiple skills.
ai_s2_accel: Machine-vision inspection replacing manual visual checks
Assembly error prevention and torque-data traceability
AR work-instruction cards
Digital-twin optimization of assembly processes
ai_s2_auto: Digital time tracking and production scheduling
System-based material delivery and replenishment requests
Automated test-data recording
Robotic operation of standard processes
ai_s3_list: Drawing interpretation: identify key assembly requirements from drawings.
Fine manual work: precise wiring, fastening, and alignment.
Exception judgment: recognize unusual sounds, binding, and incorrect assembly.
Cross-process collaboration: communicate with commissioning, quality, and process teams.
Equipment commissioning: perform powered tests and basic troubleshooting.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places electromechanical assembly in the low-to-moderate exposure range. Automation is taking over standardized, repetitive stations, while people still handle small-batch, complex, custom assembly and commissioning. Less-standardized work is more resilient; repetitive work faces more pressure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-to-moderate exposure does not mean the occupation can ignore change. Production-line automation is accelerating. Assemblers should move toward commissioning, maintenance, and quality roles that machines cannot yet perform reliably.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For students who want to enter manufacturing without competing on academic credentials, electromechanical training offers a practical route. Vocational high school or an associate degree can lead to factory work, and electrical or fitter certificates add value. Do not stop at basic assembly. Develop commissioning, maintenance, and automation skills to improve resilience.

Learn commissioning and troubleshooting, then work toward automated-line maintenance. Build PLC and servo-control skills. Moving from machine assembler to equipment troubleshooter can improve both pay and career resilience.

Candidates with assembly experience in electronics or automotive-parts factories can apply directly. Others can start as apprentices. In interviews, emphasize attention to detail, reliability, and willingness to work overtime. To advance, learn to read drawings and obtain an electrical certificate.

Assembler turnover is high. Retention depends on transparent piece-rate pay and a clear skill-progression path. Training multi-skilled workers internally and retaining people who can commission and maintain equipment can cost less than repeated hiring.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Virtual annotations of key assembly points

ai_s7_trends: Standard stations continue to automate, reducing lower-skill assembly roles.
Demand is rising for small-batch custom assembly and commissioning.
Multi-skilled workers who can assemble, commission, and maintain equipment command more value.

body: Electromechanical Equipment Assemblers follow drawings and process requirements to combine mechanical parts, electrical components, wire harnesses, and controls into electromechanical equipment. They also perform functional tests and quality inspections. This is a foundational technical occupation on equipment-manufacturing lines.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机电设备装配工在岗约 26.14 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 27.33 万人，净增约 1.19 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.96 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.40 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会完全取代机电设备装配工，但会重构这个岗位：标准化工位的装配动作正被机器人和自动化线体替代，剩下的是「设备调试、异常处理、质量把关」这类需要判断力的活，装配工要向多技能工人转型。
ai_s2_accel: 视觉检测替代人工目检
装配防错与扭矩数据追溯
AR 工艺指导卡
装配过程数字孪生优化
ai_s2_auto: 工时统计与排产数字化
物料配送与叫料系统化
检测数据自动记录
标准工序机器人作业
ai_s3_list: 看图能力：从图纸抓装配要点。
精细手活：接线、锁紧、对位的精度。
异常判断：异响、卡滞、错装的直觉。
跨工序协作：跟调试、质检、工艺沟通。
设备调试：通电测试与简单排故。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明机电装配是「中高曝光」的制造工种：标准化重复工位正在被自动化蚕食，但小批量、复杂、非标的装配和调试仍靠人，属于「越非标越安全、越重复越危险」。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高枕无忧：产线自动化在加速，往调试、维护、质检这些「机器暂时替代不了」的岗位走，才是装配工的正确姿势。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 不想卷学历又想进制造业，机电专业是稳妥选择：中专大专就能进厂，电工证、钳工证尽早考。但别满足于「只会装配」，引导孩子往调试、维修、自动化方向学，抗替代能力完全不同。
主动学调试和排故，争取转自动化线体维护岗；PLC、伺服控制这些技能补起来，从「装机手」升级成「设备医生」，工资和安全感都上台阶。
有电子厂、汽配厂装配经验的直接投；没经验的从学徒做起，面试突出细心、稳定性和加班意愿。想往上走，先把图纸和电工证拿下。
装配工流动性大，留人靠「计件透明 + 技能晋升通道」。与其招了再走，不如内部培养多技能工，把会调试、会维护的人留住，成本更低。

ai_s7_trends: 标准工位持续自动化，低端装配岗位收缩。
小批量、非标装配与调试岗位需求上升。
多技能工人（装配+调试+维护）更值钱。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can remind someone to take medication and record vital signs, but when an older adult holds your hand and says, “I don't want to move today,” a person still has to encourage them.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 4,347,700 personal care workers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 5,087,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 739,800 jobs, with about 765,800 openings annually and a 2026 median annual salary of about $34,900 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace personal care aides, and aging will only increase care demand. AI will take over health monitoring, medication reminders, and record organization, but machines cannot enter the intimate work of dressing, feeding, repositioning, and companionship. The truly scarce aides are willing, skilled, and warmhearted.
ai_s2_accel: Wearable devices monitor vital signs in real time
AI fall detection and emergency alerts
Voice assistants support communication and reminders
Intelligent care-plan and risk recommendations
ai_s2_auto: Scheduling and home-visit routing software
Digitization of care records and health data
Medication reminders and intake-record prompts
Automatic collection and upload of vital-sign data
ai_s3_list: Hands-on personal care: machines cannot properly reposition, transfer, or bathe people.
Emotional companionship and trust: earning an older adult's reliance takes years of consistent care.
Emergency response: a person's first reaction matters in falls, choking, and emotional episodes.
Reading subtle cues: when an older adult cannot describe discomfort, you must notice it.
Patience and dignity: remaining gentle through tedious repetition is professional mastery.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 means that most of this occupation is hands-on personal service. Few desk-based stages can be standardized by algorithms, mainly records and scheduling.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-to-high exposure still brings change. Smart monitoring and care software improve efficiency but do not reduce staffing needs. Unlicensed, unskilled, brute-force care models will be screened out, while certified professional aides become even scarcer.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study elder services and management, nursing, or a related field and earn certifications early. AI-era care roles require equipment and data literacy; relevant education plus credentials open more employment options than expected.

Earn advanced credentials such as health care worker or elder care worker certification and master smart monitoring equipment. Move toward disability care, rehabilitation care, or management to leave purely physical work behind.

Patience and a service mindset are enough to begin. Start as an aide in an elder care institution and earn credentials while working. On your resume, describe the conditions you have cared for and the nursing skills you learned, which is more credible than abstract claims of compassion.

Assess emergency response + communication when hiring aides: What would they do if an older adult fell, and how would they answer a family complaint? Certified, reliable aides who understand data deserve higher pay and advancement paths.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Heart rate, blood pressure, and sleep monitoring
Reduce effort in transfers and repositioning

ai_s7_trends: Long-term care demand continues to grow with population aging, leaving a persistent labor shortage.
As smart monitoring and care software spread, aides advance toward equipment and data skills.
Professionalization and certification are advancing. Low-threshold models consolidate, while professional aides become more sought after.

body: Personal care aides provide daily living assistance to older adults, patients, and people with disabilities in homes or institutions, including hygiene, food, mobility assistance, health monitoring, and emotional companionship. They are frontline workers in elder and long-term care systems.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能提醒吃药、记录体征，但老人拉着你的手说「今天不想动」，还是得人哄着来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年个人护理在岗约 434.77 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 508.75 万人，净增约 73.98 万个岗位，年均产生约 76.58 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.49 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代个人护理员，老龄化带来的照护需求只会越来越大。AI 会接管健康监测、用药提醒、记录整理这些环节，但穿衣、喂饭、翻身、陪伴这些贴身服务，机器进不来。真正稀缺的，是肯干、会干、又暖人心的护理员。
ai_s2_accel: 智能穿戴设备实时监测体征
AI 跌倒检测与紧急告警
语音助手辅助沟通与提醒
照护计划与风险的智能建议
ai_s2_auto: 排班与上门路线的调度软件
护理记录与健康数据的电子化
用药提醒与服药记录提醒
体征数据的自动采集与上传
ai_s3_list: 贴身照护的手法：翻身、转移、擦洗，机器做不到也做不好。
情感陪伴与信任：让老人愿意依赖你，是长年累月攒出来的。
突发应对：跌倒、噎食、情绪波动，第一反应靠人。
察言观色：老人说不清哪里不舒服，你得看得出来。
耐心与尊严感：在繁琐重复里保持温柔，这是职业修为。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业绝大多数时间是贴身服务，能被算法标准化的桌面环节很少——主要是记录和调度。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化：智能监测和照护软件会提升效率，但不会减少对人手的需要。真正被筛选掉的，是无证、无技能、靠蛮力的模式，持证、专业的护理员反而更紧缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读老年服务与管理、护理相关专业，尽早考证。AI 时代照护岗位要懂设备、会看数据，专业出身加证书，就业面比想象宽。
考健康照护师、养老护理员等更高级证书，把智能监测设备用熟。往失能照护、康复照护、管理岗方向走，脱离纯体力阶段。
有耐心和服务意识就能入门，从养老机构护工做起，边做边考证。简历上写「照顾过什么状况的老人、学会哪些护理技能」，比空谈爱心更可信。
招护理员要考「应急处理 + 沟通」：老人跌倒怎么办、家属投诉怎么答。持证、稳定、会看数据的护理员，值得给更高薪酬和晋升通道。

ai_s7_trends: 长期照护需求随老龄化持续增长，岗位缺口长期存在。
智能监测与照护软件普及，护理员向「会设备、懂数据」升级。
行业专业化、持证化推进，低门槛模式被整合，专业护理员更吃香。

body: 个人护理员为老人、病患与失能者在家庭或机构中提供日常生活照料，涵盖清洁、饮食、移动辅助、健康监测与情感陪伴，是养老与长期照护体系的一线力量。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can predict high-crime-risk areas, help identify suspects, and generate reports, but an officer's mind and hands will always decide whether to calm or control first and whether to draw a weapon at the scene.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 698,800 police and patrol officers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 720,800 by 2034, a net increase of about 22,000 jobs, with about 53,700 openings annually and a 2026 median annual salary of about $76,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace police, but it will profoundly change policing. Predictive policing, facial recognition, case analysis, and report generation are spreading, giving patrol and emergency response stronger data support. Yet law enforcement requires people at unpredictable scenes, where AI cannot replace use-of-force decisions, public communication, and real-time response.
ai_s2_accel: Predictive policing models assist resource deployment
Drones assist patrol and search and rescue
AI automatically annotates body-camera footage
Intelligent correlation analysis of case intelligence
ai_s2_auto: Emergency-call analysis and report generation
Intelligent optimization of patrol routes
Assisted facial and vehicle recognition
Electronic law-enforcement records and evidence management
ai_s3_list: On-site response: judgment at the moment before conflict escalates.
Proportional enforcement: balance rules and human considerations.
Public communication: talk a confrontation back toward peace.
Real-time adaptability: make rapid decisions in emergencies.
Physical endurance: essential for pursuits, duty, and shifts.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 means automation concentrates in data layers such as intelligence, recognition, and records. Predictive policing, facial recognition, and report generation assist officers, but law-enforcement scenes are real, chaotic, and unpredictable; AI cannot replace officers' judgment and communication.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate risk does not permit complacency. AI disadvantages officers who only run errands and cannot use data. Teams using predictive policing and analytics can place officers where they matter most. Technology is the assistant; the scene is the main arena.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Policing is a stable but demanding public-sector career. Before applying, consider physical health, mental health, and family support. Police academies and civil-service police recruitment are the standard entry paths. Train physically, earn strong scores, and after entry build field experience and specialized skills instead of only waiting for promotion.

Develop data analysis and intelligence assessment and move toward criminal investigation, cybersecurity, anti-fraud, or another specialty. Protect mental health and balance duty pressure with family relationships; body and mindset sustain a long career.

People with military, firefighting, or security backgrounds have advantages in police-related roles. Public recruitment windows are limited, so monitor auxiliary-police and special recruitment channels, gain frontline experience, and pursue permanent status and promotion.

Frontline police shortages are routine. Retain staff through technology + psychological support + training and promotion. Equip frontline teams with smart dispatch and body-camera systems, freeing officers from repetitive reports for on-site response.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Intelligently dispatch officers based on incident location

ai_s7_trends: Predictive policing and intelligent recognition spread, improving deployment precision.
Law-enforcement records and evidence management become fully electronic, increasing transparency.
Governance of emerging crimes such as fraud and cybercrime becomes a policing priority.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能预判哪里犯罪风险高、帮你识别嫌疑人、自动生成报告，但警情现场「先安抚还是先控制、该不该拔枪」的判断，永远靠警察的大脑和手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年警察与巡逻警官在岗约 69.88 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 72.08 万人，净增约 2.20 万个岗位，年均产生约 5.37 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.63 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代警察，但会深度改变警务方式：预测性警务、人脸识别、案件分析、报告生成都在普及，巡逻和接警变得更「有数据支撑」。但执法是「人到现场、现场判断」的工作，武力决策、群众沟通和临场处置，AI 替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: 预测性警务模型辅助警力部署
无人机辅助巡逻与搜救
执法记录仪结合 AI 自动标注
案件情报的智能关联分析
ai_s2_auto: 报警案件分析与报告生成
巡逻路线的智能调度优化
人脸识别与车辆识别辅助
执法记录与证据管理电子化
ai_s3_list: 现场处置：冲突升级前的那一刻判断。
执法分寸：规则与人情的平衡。
群众沟通：把对立场面讲回和平。
临场应变：突发状况下的快速决策。
体能耐力：追捕、执勤和倒班的硬条件。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这行的自动化集中在「情报、识别、记录」这些数据层：预测性警务、人脸识别、报告生成都在辅助，但执法现场是真实的、混乱的、不可预测的，警察的现场判断和沟通能力 AI 替代不了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中风险不等于高枕无忧：AI 会让「只会跑腿、不会用数据」的民警效率吃亏；会用预测性警务、数据分析工具的警队，能把警力放到最关键的地方。技术是帮手，现场才是主战场。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 警察是稳定但辛苦的体制内职业，报考前要想清楚身体、心理和家庭支持。警校或招警考试是正门，提前练体能、考个好成绩，入职后别只等升迁，多积累现场经验和专业警种技能。
把数据分析、情报研判这些新技能补起来，往刑侦、网安、反诈等专业方向走。注意心理健康，处理好执勤压力和家庭关系，身体和心态是干长久的本钱。
有部队、消防、安保背景的人转警务相关岗位有优势。社会招聘窗口有限，紧盯辅警招录和特招渠道，先把基层经验攒起来，再争取转正和晋升。
基层警力紧张是常态，用「科技装备 + 心理关爱 + 培训晋升」留人。给一线配好智能调度和执法记录设备，把警力从重复报表里解放出来，放到现场处置上。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 预测高发警情区域与时段

ai_s7_trends: 预测性警务与智能识别普及，警力部署更精准。
执法记录与证据管理全面电子化，执法更透明。
反诈、网安等新型犯罪治理成为警务重点。

body: 警察与巡逻警官指在辖区街面执行巡逻防控、接警处置、交通执法、治安管理与案件初步调查的执法警务人员，是维护公共安全和社会秩序的一线力量。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can monitor thousands of camera feeds and generate automated alerts, but when an alarm sounds, a security manager must decide whether to escalate the response and how to direct personnel on site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 151,400 security managers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 157,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 5,700 jobs, with approximately 13,200 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $104,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace security managers, but it will reshape the role. Video analytics, intelligent access control, and patrol robots are taking over basic tasks such as watching surveillance feeds and checking attendance, freeing security managers from labor-intensive supervision. The remaining duties of risk assessment, emergency planning, incident command, cross-functional coordination, and compliance accountability are precisely the leadership functions AI cannot replace.
ai_s2_accel: AI behavior analytics and anomaly alerts
Intelligent security staff scheduling and workforce optimization
AI identification of hazards in risk registers
Digital emergency command and dispatch platforms
ai_s2_auto: Automated alerts from AI video analytics
Intelligent access control and facial-recognition entry
Automated patrol attendance and report generation
Automated archiving of security incident records
ai_s3_list: Risk assessment: turn hazards into actionable corrective items through experience and judgment.
Emergency command: calmly allocate resources during real incidents; no one can replace on-site human decisions.
Team management: retaining and effectively managing a security team requires genuine skill.
Multi-party coordination: people work with property management, legal, fire services, and police.
Compliance accountability: the responsible security officer's signature represents real accountability, not a formality.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 describes a management role where technology can be automated but people carry responsibility. AI and systems take over monitoring alerts, patrols, and scheduling, while risk assessment, emergency command, and team management remain the manager's core value.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure means traditional security managers who only manage guard scheduling are losing value. Learn intelligent security systems, data-based analysis, and emergency management, and advance from labor-intensive supervision to hybrid technology + management leadership. AI then becomes a tool that improves your efficiency.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Students pursuing security management can prioritize fire protection engineering, safety engineering, or emergency management and earn registered safety engineer credentials. Participate in emergency exercises and project management practice during college because management roles place great value on real-world experience.

Do not remain someone who only manages guards. Learn intelligent security systems, emergency command platforms, and data analysis; earn credentials such as registered safety engineer; and advance toward regional security director or risk management roles.

People with fire protection, property management, administrative, or military backgrounds generally transition smoothly. Start as a security supervisor or fire protection specialist and earn credentials while working. In interviews, highlight experience organizing drills and handling incidents.

As intelligent security becomes widespread, evaluate security manager candidates primarily on emergency command and system coordination capabilities, not only guard-management experience. Provide training budgets for credentials and retain core personnel through responsibility + advancement.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Closed-loop hazard management and corrective-action tracking

ai_s7_trends: As intelligent security systems become widespread, security managers shift from labor-intensive supervision toward hybrid technology + data + emergency management.
Companies increase investment in security compliance, making credentials and emergency-command capabilities core competitive advantages.
As AI alerts and risk assessment tools are deployed, security managers increasingly rely on data-based analysis for decisions.

body: Security managers oversee security operations for companies or facilities, coordinating security personnel management, risk assessment, surveillance and access-control systems, emergency plans and drills, incident response, and compliance corrective actions to protect people, property, and information.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can monitor thousands of camera feeds and generate automated alerts, but when an alarm sounds, a security manager must decide whether to escalate the response and how to direct personnel on site.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能盯着几千路摄像头自动告警，但告警响起来时「该不该升级处置、怎么指挥现场」——这个决定，得由安全经理扛。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年安全经理在岗约 15.14 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 15.71 万人，净增约 0.57 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.32 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.47 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代安全经理，但会重塑这个岗位。视频分析、智能门禁、巡更机器人正在接管「盯监控、查打卡」的基础工作，让安全经理从「人海管理」里解放出来。剩下的风险评估、预案设计、应急指挥、跨部门协调和合规责任，恰恰是 AI 替代不了的领导职能。
ai_s2_accel: AI 行为分析与异常预警
安保智能排班与人力优化
风险台账与隐患 AI 识别
应急指挥与调度数字化平台
ai_s2_auto: AI 视频分析自动告警
智能门禁与人脸识别通行
巡更打卡与报表自动生成
安防事件记录自动归档
ai_s3_list: 风险评估：把隐患变成可执行的整改项，靠经验和判断。
应急指挥：真出事时冷静调度，现场决策没人替得了。
团队管理：保安队留得住、管得动，是门学问。
多方协调：物业、法务、消防、公安，靠人对接。
合规责任：安全责任人的签字，是担责不是过场。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这是个「技术可自动化、责任靠人扛」的管理岗：监控告警、巡更排班这些被 AI 和系统接管，但风险评估、应急指挥和团队管理依然是经理的核心价值。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光意味着「只会管保安排班」的传统安全经理在贬值。把智能安防系统、数据研判和应急管理学到手，从「人海管理者」升级成「技术 + 管理」的复合型安全负责人，AI 反而是帮你提效的工具。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 孩子想走安全管理方向，可优先学消防工程、安全工程、应急管理专业，考注册安全工程师。大学多参加应急演练和项目管理实践，管理岗很看重实战履历。
别停留在「管保安」。把智能安防系统、应急指挥平台和数据分析学起来，考取注册安全工程师等证书，往区域安全总监、风险管理方向走。
有消防、物业、行政或退役军人背景的转行较顺。从安保主管、消防专员切入，边做边考证书；面试突出「组织过演练、处置过事件」的经历。
智能安防普及后，招安全经理重点看应急指挥和系统统筹能力，别只看保安管理经验。建议提供培训预算支持考证书，用「责任 + 晋升」绑定核心骨干。

ai_s7_trends: 智能安防系统普及，安全经理从「人海管理」转向「技术 + 数据 + 应急」复合管理。
企业对安全合规投入增加，持证与应急指挥能力成为核心竞争力。
AI 预警与风险评估工具落地，安全经理的决策越来越依赖数据研判。

body: 安全经理负责企业或场所的安全运营，统筹安保人员管理、风险评估、监控与门禁系统、应急预案与演练、事件响应与合规整改，保障人员、财产与信息安全。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Price comparisons and ticketing can be completed with one click, but when an entire family is stranded at a foreign airport, a travel advisor still makes late-night calls to coordinate rebooking.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 65,700 travel agents were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 67,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,500 jobs, with approximately 7,100 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $48,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace travel advisors, but it will take over price comparisons and booking. OTAs and AI make standard flight and hotel reservations self-service, shifting advisors from placing orders to creating custom trips, handling emergencies, and building trust. Those who only make reservations without providing service will be squeezed out, while advisors who can design complex itineraries and solve crises will become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: AI itinerary recommendations and personalized group tours
Customer service chatbots for common questions
Intelligent destination risk alerts
Customer profile-driven product recommendations
ai_s2_auto: Flight and hotel price comparison and automated booking
Automated generation of itineraries and travel documents
Checklist-based assistance with visa documents
Automated flight status alerts
ai_s3_list: Custom design: people interpret preferences.
Emergency support: people coordinate help when travelers are stranded.
Trust building: people cultivate relationships.
Complex group arrangements: people coordinate all parties.
Special needs: people care for older adults and children.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 rating means this occupation has moderately high exposure in booking work. Systems are taking over price comparisons and ticketing, but people retain a role in customization and emergency support.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Standard booking actions are being replaced, not roles that provide customization and emergency support. Advisors who can manage complex itineraries, solve crises, and earn trust become even scarcer as OTAs expand. Those who only book without providing service face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation through vocational or associate-level study in tourism or foreign languages, and practice destination and visa knowledge while in school. Pure booking work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop customization and emergency support skills early.
Advance from placing orders to creating custom trips and managing groups. Learn product management and customer relationship skills, and pursue roles as a custom travel designer or branch manager.
Highlight your customization and emergency support experience, and specify the routes and groups you have handled. Travel agencies value reliability and familiarity.
Do not hire based only on booking ability. Assess whether candidates can customize trips and handle emergencies. People who can build customer trust are worth higher commissions.

ai_s7_trends: OTAs are taking standard bookings while demand for custom travel rises.
AI itinerary recommendations make group travel more personalized.
Advisors who provide emergency support and earn trust are in greater demand.

body: Travel agents design, book, and coordinate trips for travelers. They integrate transportation, accommodation, and activities, arrange visas and insurance, and provide contingency support during flight cancellations, sudden weather changes, and other disruptions to keep travel running smoothly.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 比价和出单系统能一键搞定，但客人一家老小困在异国机场，还是顾问半夜打电话协调改签。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年旅行顾问在岗约 6.57 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.72 万人，净增约 0.15 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.71 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.84 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代旅行顾问，但会接管比价与出单。OTA 和 AI 把标准机酒自助化，顾问从「下订单」挪向「做定制、兜底突发、建信任」。真正被挤掉的是只代订不服务的人，能做复杂行程、会救火的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: AI 行程推荐与个性拼团
客服机器人的常见问答
目的地风险的智能提示
客户画像驱动的产品推荐
ai_s2_auto: 机酒比价与自动预订
行程单与资料的自动生成
签证材料的清单化辅助
航班动态的自动提醒
ai_s3_list: 定制设计：偏好靠人读。
突发兜底：被困靠人协调。
信任建立：关系靠人经营。
复杂拼团：多方靠人串。
特殊需求：老人小孩靠人顾。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的预订区——比价出单被系统接管，但定制兜底留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「下标准单」动作，不是「做定制兜底」的岗位。能做复杂行程、会救火、有信任的顾问，反而随 OTA 更稀缺。怕的是只代订不服务的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 旅游外语类中专大专打底，在校多练目的地和签证。AI 时代纯代订在缩，早点练定制和兜底。
从「下订单」升级成「做定制 + 管团」，学产品和客户经营，争取转定制师或门店管理。
突出定制和兜底经验，写清做过哪些线路和团。旅行社看重稳和熟。
招人别只看会下单，要看会不会定制兜底。能经营客户信任的，值得给高佣金。

ai_s7_trends: OTA 吃标准单，定制游需求升。
AI 行程推荐让拼团更个性。
会兜底、有信任的顾问更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Thermal imaging reports can be generated automatically, but technicians still determine on site where the draft originates.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) does not publish a median wage for this detailed occupation because the data are suppressed. This page does not invent a figure (BLS OES, 2025).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace weatherization installers, but it will upgrade diagnostics. AI can read thermal images and flag suspicious cold spots, software can generate inspection reports, and energy data can be compared automatically, making inspections faster. Construction cannot be automated: proper weatherstripping, even insulation, and tightly wrapped pipes all depend on skilled hands and on-site judgment beyond AI's reach.
ai_s2_accel: AI image recognition to help locate air leaks
Remote monitoring of retrofit results with smart temperature and humidity sensors
Rapid simulation of energy savings with retrofit planning software
Drone thermal imaging inspections of roofs and facades
ai_s2_auto: Automatic annotation and generation of thermal imaging reports
Energy-use data collection and comparative analysis
Automatic dispatch of construction checklists and work orders
Electronic completion of energy-efficiency assessment forms
ai_s3_list: Air leak diagnosis: beyond thermal imaging, hidden leaks require touch and experience.
On-site workmanship: detailed finishing and joints for weatherstripping and insulation.
Plan communication: clearly explain what will change, expected savings, and project duration to homeowners.
Safe work: protect oneself when working at height, around dust, and in confined spaces.
Trade coordination: coordinate handoffs and inspections with plumbing, electrical, and HVAC crews.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 rating means software is taking over much of the inspection and recordkeeping, but construction represents a large share of the job, limiting AI's direct reach.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure still brings change. Technicians who operate diagnostic instruments and interpret AI reports are increasingly valuable, while basic caulking work is being standardized. The future dividing line is whether a worker can turn diagnostic data into a retrofit plan. Those who can are technicians; those who cannot remain installers.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study building energy efficiency, HVAC, or renewable energy and gain practical experience with thermal imaging and energy testing. Weatherization has strong policy support, and early entrants with complete credentials can become diagnostic technicians within several years.

Learn diagnostic instruments and planning software and advance from installer to a technician who handles diagnostics plus planning. Earn relevant weatherization certifications, which are firm requirements for government-funded projects.

People with plumbing, electrical, HVAC, or renovation experience can transition fastest. In applications, specify the diagnostic equipment you use and retrofit projects you completed independently; this is more useful than simply stating construction ability.

Do not recruit weatherization workers as ordinary renovation labor. Technicians who diagnose, develop plans, and write reports are core assets. Appropriate premium pay improves delivery quality and customer retention.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Locate cold spots and air leak sources
Compare energy use before and after retrofits
Thermal review of roofs and exterior walls
Remote transmission of temperature and humidity

ai_s7_trends: Diagnostics become fully instrumented, and AI analysis becomes the standard front end for weatherization.
Carbon reduction and older-neighborhood renovation policies continue to generate projects.
Versatile technicians who integrate diagnostics, planning, and construction become scarce.

body: Weatherization installers and technicians retrofit existing homes for energy efficiency. They identify air leaks and energy weaknesses, install window and door sealing, insulation, pipe wrapping, and ventilation upgrades, and help residents reduce energy use and costs.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 热成像报告可以自动生成，但「这口风从哪进来的」还是技师现场拍板。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 未发布该职业细分口径的中位数（口径抑制），本页不编造数字（BLS OES，2025）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代节能改造安装工，但会升级检测端：AI 读热成像自动标出可疑冷点、软件一键生成检测报告、能耗数据自动对比——这些让检测越来越快。但施工端没法自动化：密封条贴得服不服帖、保温棉铺得均不均匀、管线包得密不密实，全靠手感和现场判断，这是 AI 碰不到的部分。
ai_s2_accel: AI 图像识别辅助定位漏风点
智能温湿度传感器远程监测改造效果
改造方案软件快速模拟节能收益
无人机热成像巡检屋顶与外立面
ai_s2_auto: 热成像报告的自动标注与生成
能耗数据采集与对比分析
施工清单与工单的自动派发
能效评估表的电子化填写
ai_s3_list: 漏风源判断：热成像之外，靠手感与经验定位隐蔽漏点。
现场施工工艺：密封条、保温棉的收边与衔接细节。
方案沟通：跟户主讲清改什么、能省多少、工期多长。
安全作业：高空、粉尘、狭小空间的自我保护。
多工种协调：与水电、暖通、电工班组交接验收。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的检测与记录环节正被软件大幅接管，但施工占比高，AI 实际接触面不大。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于零变化：会操作检测仪器、会读 AI 报告的技师越来越吃香，纯打胶施工的工人在被标准化。未来的分水岭是「能不能从检测数据里定出改造方案」——能，就是技师；不能，就是施工工。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读建筑节能、暖通或新能源相关专业，把热成像、能耗检测这些实操练熟。节能改造正处在政策风口，入行早、证书全，几年就能当检测技师。
把检测仪器和方案软件学起来，从「施工工」升级成「检测 + 方案」的技师。考节能改造相关认证，接政府项目单时认证是硬门槛。
有水电、暖通、装修经验的人转型最快。求职时写清你会用哪些检测设备、独立做过什么改造项目，比只写「会施工」有用。
别把节能改造当普通装修工招。能检测、会定方案、能写报告的技师是核心资产，给到合理溢价，项目交付质量和客户复购率都会上来。

ai_s7_trends: 检测全面仪器化，AI 诊断成为节能改造标准前端。
双碳与老旧小区改造政策持续给行业供单。
检测、方案、施工一体化的复合技师成为稀缺人才。

body: 节能改造安装工与技术员负责对既有住宅实施节能改造：检测漏风与能耗薄弱点，施工门窗密封、保温隔热、管线包裹与通风改造，帮助住户降低能耗与开支。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 热成像报告可以自动生成，但「这口风从哪进来的」还是技师现场拍板。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can identify hundreds of prospects and automatically generate quotes, but a person sitting across the table still needs to understand whether a purchasing manager truly cares more about price or delivery speed.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 1,310,500 wholesale and manufacturing sales representatives, excluding technical and scientific products, were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to rise to 1,314,900, a net gain of about 4,400 jobs, with approximately 114,800 openings each year. For 2026, the median annual wage is about $66,800 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will replace many sales-process tasks. CRM and AI sales tools are taking over lead generation, customer profiling, automated quoting, and order follow-up. The core of sales, however, still depends on people: understanding needs, building trusted relationships, negotiating complex terms, and maintaining accounts. The AI era removes message-carrying salespeople and retains consultative salespeople.
ai_s2_accel: AI sales forecasts and follow-up reminders
Intelligent sales scripts and training support
Automated insight into customer needs
Online trade shows and digital customer acquisition
ai_s2_auto: AI lead generation and customer profiling
Automated quotes and order generation
Automatic entry of customer information into CRM
Automated analysis of sales-data reports
ai_s3_list: Needs discovery: hear the customer's real pain points in brief, indirect remarks.
Relationship trust: at critical moments, long-term customers trust you as a person.
Business negotiation: balancing price, payment terms, and service requires judgment in the room.
Solutions: present products as a way to save customers money and effort.
Account maintenance: keep the relationship intact when contacts leave or purchasing staff change.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 means sales processes are highly data-driven. Tools already handle leads, quotes, and follow-ups, shifting representatives from running processes toward building relationships and developing solutions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-high exposure does not mean sales will disappear; salespeople who cannot use tools will. AI screens leads, remembers customer details, and drafts proposals, freeing time for visits and negotiations. Consultative salespeople who understand products, possess industry relationships, and use tools effectively become even more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Sales is not determined by academic credentials, but a technical background + industry knowledge provides a strong start. To enter industrial sales, first study a manufacturing-related field, then add sales methods. Complete internships during college; resilience and confidence develop through practice.

Master CRM and AI sales tools, then invest the saved time in industry and customer expertise. Move toward key-account management and solution sales. Customer relationships are your strongest asset, enabling you to change employers without abandoning your market.

The entry barrier for a sales career transition is relatively low, but prepare to endure an initial period of building customers. On your résumé, emphasize market coverage, account maintenance, and results. Candidates with manufacturing backgrounds should prioritize aligned industries.

After introducing AI tools, hire salespeople for needs insight and relationship-management ability, not just scripts. Retain core talent through clear customer-account ownership + transparent commissions so employees do not leave with the customers.

ai_s7_trends: Sales processes become fully digital, with AI taking over leads and quotes as representatives transition into customer advisors.
Customer relationships and industry networks become core assets, creating clear premiums for key-account managers and solution salespeople.
Industrial sales and trade shows move online, maturing a customer-acquisition model that combines digital and in-person channels.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能筛出几百个潜在客户、自动生成报价单，但「这个采购经理真正在意的是价格还是交付速度」——这份洞察，还得靠坐在对面的人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年批发与制造业销售代表（不含技术与科学产品）在岗约 131.05 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 131.49 万人，净增约 0.44 万个岗位，年均产生约 11.48 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.68 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 会替代大量销售流程操作：线索挖掘、客户画像、自动报价、订单跟进，正被 CRM 和 AI 销售工具接管。但销售的核心——需求洞察、关系信任、复杂谈判、客情维护——依然靠人。AI 时代淘汰的是「传话型销售」，留下的是「顾问型销售」。
ai_s2_accel: AI 销售预测与跟单提醒
智能话术与培训辅助
客户需求自动洞察
线上展会与数字化获客
ai_s2_auto: AI 线索挖掘与客户画像
自动报价与订单生成
CRM 客户信息自动录入
销售数据报表自动分析
ai_s3_list: 需求挖掘：从客户的只言片语里听出真实痛点。
关系信任：长期客户的关键时刻，信的是你这个人。
商务谈判：价格、账期、服务的博弈，靠现场分寸。
解决方案：把产品讲成「帮客户省钱省心」的方案。
客情维护：客户离职、换采购，关系还能不断线。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明销售流程的数据化程度很高：线索、报价、跟单都已被工具接管，销售代表的工作重心从「跑流程」转向「跑关系、做方案」。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于销售会消失，而是「不会用工具的销售会消失」。AI 帮你筛线索、记客户、写方案，让你把时间花在拜访和谈判上；懂产品、有资源、会用工具的顾问型销售，价值反而被放大。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 销售不是学历决定的行当，但理工科背景+行业知识是好起点。想进工业品销售，可以先学制造业相关专业，再补销售方法论；大学多实习，脸皮和抗压是练出来的。
把 CRM 和 AI 销售工具用熟，省下的时间深耕行业和客户。往大客户经理、解决方案销售方向走，客户资源是最硬的资产，换行不换客。
销售转行门槛相对低，但要有「先吃苦积累客户」的准备。投简历突出「跑过市场、维护过客户、完成过业绩」；有制造业背景的优先选对口行业。
AI 工具上线后，招销售重点看需求洞察和关系维护能力，别只看话术。建议用「客户资源归属 + 透明提成」留住骨干，防止人才带着客户流失。

ai_s7_trends: 销售流程全面数字化，线索与报价被 AI 接管，销售代表向「客户顾问」转型。
客户关系与行业资源成为核心资产，大客户经理与解决方案销售溢价明显。
工业品销售线上化与展会数字化，线上线下结合的获客模式成熟。
